proof_body:
by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ, ∀ m r, A m r =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Fin m → Fin 2 => (∑ i, ((s i : ℕ) + 1)) % 3 = r)).card :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have step : ∀ m r : ℕ, r < 3 → A (m + 1) r = A m ((r + 2) % 3) + A m ((r + 1) % 3) := by
    intro m r hr
    simp only [hA, Finset.card_filter]
    rw [← (Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => Fin 2)).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have e1 : ∀ S : ℕ, (1 + S) % 3 = r ↔ S % 3 = (r + 2) % 3 := by
      intro S; omega
    have e2 : ∀ S : ℕ, (2 + S) % 3 = r ↔ S % 3 = (r + 1) % 3 := by
      intro S; omega
    congr 1
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s _
      have e : (∑ i, (((Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => Fin 2)) ((0 : Fin 2), s) i : ℕ) + 1)) = 1 + ∑ i, ((s i : ℕ) + 1) := by
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.consEquiv]
      rw [e]
      exact if_congr (e1 _) rfl rfl
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s _
      have e : (∑ i, (((Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => Fin 2)) ((1 : Fin 2), s) i : ℕ) + 1)) = 2 + ∑ i, ((s i : ℕ) + 1) := by
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.consEquiv]
      rw [e]
      exact if_congr (e2 _) rfl rfl
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, (A m 0 : ℝ) = 2 ^ m * (1 / 3 + 2 / 3 * (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ∧
      (A m 1 : ℝ) = 2 ^ m * (1 / 3 - 1 / 3 * (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ∧
      (A m 2 : ℝ) = 2 ^ m * (1 / 3 - 1 / 3 * (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      have h0 : A 0 0 = 1 := by rw [hA]; decide
      have h1 : A 0 1 = 0 := by rw [hA]; decide
      have h2 : A 0 2 = 0 := by rw [hA]; decide
      rw [h0, h1, h2]
      norm_num
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨i0, i1, i2⟩ := ih
      have s0 : A (k + 1) 0 = A k 2 + A k 1 := step k 0 (by norm_num)
      have s1 : A (k + 1) 1 = A k 0 + A k 2 := step k 1 (by norm_num)
      have s2 : A (k + 1) 2 = A k 1 + A k 0 := step k 2 (by norm_num)
      rw [s0, s1, s2]
      push_cast
      rw [i0, i1, i2, pow_succ (2 : ℝ) k, pow_succ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) k]
      refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩
  intro n
  have e : Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Fin n → Fin 2 => 3 ∣ ∑ i, ((s i : ℕ) + 1)) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Fin n → Fin 2 => (∑ i, ((s i : ℕ) + 1)) % 3 = 0) :=
    Finset.filter_congr (fun s _ => by omega)
  rw [e, ← hA, (key n).1]
  exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (by positivity)
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Fin n → Fin 2 => 3 ∣ ∑ i, ((s i : ℕ) + 1))).card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n = 1 / 3 + 2 / 3 * (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n
